Show the CLI settings: the API and dashboard URLs, the credential in use (masked), the default
project and the linked directories.

Settings live in ~/.voidhash. With --profile (or VOIDHASH_PROFILE) a named profile's settings
override the base ones, such as a staging server's URLs.

Usage:
  voidhash config [flags]
  voidhash config <command> [flags]

Commands:
  set        Set a CLI setting: api_url, web_url or default_project.
  reset      Return the API and dashboard URLs to their defaults.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash config
  voidhash config set api_url https://api.staging.example.com --profile staging
  voidhash config reset --profile staging

Run 'voidhash config <command> --help' for more about a command.
